text:
julia-rep: Hey team — acme-corp sees intermittent 502s and high latency on POST /v1/generate. Customer supplied a request_id: req_20260312_7c9a4b2f. Region: us-west-2, tenant: acme-corp-prod-1. Started around 2026-03-12T14:10Z. They included a curl they ran, asking for server-side log lookup and an ETA.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-4821 created and linked to thread (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4821) :white_check_mark:

devon: on it. Quick Q: do you have their raw curl + full response (with headers) and exact timestamp for the failing call? if you paste the curl i can run an ELK query.

julia-rep: pasted the curl from the customer:```curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"small test"}' \ 
  -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"```
Response they got:```HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2026 14:10:23 GMT
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"upstream error"}

502 3.67```

samir: thanks. First-pass queries I run: (ELK/Kibana)
```request_id:"req_20260312_7c9a4b2f" OR headers.x-request-id:"req_20260312_7c9a4b2f"```
KQL:```request_id : "req_20260312_7c9a4b2f"```
And check traces:```trace.request_id:"req_20260312_7c9a4b2f"```
If you share the exact minute range I’ll scope to 14:05-14:15 UTC to reduce noise. Note: edge/nginx logs retained 14d, service/app logs 30d, traces sampled for 7d — this call is within retention so we should have it.

julia-rep: exact time from customer is 2026-03-12T14:10:23Z. forwarding tenant id and I'm asking them to run a verbose capture for headers.

devon: ran the search by tenant acme-corp-prod-1 + request_id. pasted a short extract:```[runtime.v2] 2026-03-12T14:10:23Z request_id=req_20260312_7c9a4b2f upstream=worker-12 status=502 error="upstream handshake timeout" latency=3.65s
[model-server] 2026-03-12T14:10:23Z request_id=req_20260312_7c9a4b2f model=redwood-7b event=kv-cache-miss mem=11.9GB```
Looks like model-server experienced a transient stall and upstream timed out at the runtime layer. Not a clear OOM but a slow call. I’ll keep digging for logs around worker-12.

mara: FYI — I asked the customer for a debug bundle and gave them this helper to capture timing/headers:```curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"small test"}' \ 
  --trace-ascii /tmp/curl-trace.txt -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"```
And asked them to attach /tmp/curl-trace.txt to the ticket along with the full response headers. Also asked them to run our debug collector if they can:```curl -sS https://support.redwood.ai/debug-collector -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" -d '{"request_id":"req_20260312_7c9a4b2f"}' > debug-bundle.tar.gz```
(collector will gather client timings + request headers).

samir: one more quick query I ran against the trace index for correlation IDs:```service:runtime AND request_id:"req_20260312_7c9a4b2f" | sort @timestamp asc```
I see a sequence where runtime forwarded to worker-12 and then waited ~3.6s before a gateway-level retry/timeout. Could be momentary worker saturation.

devon: if customer provides the debug-bundle we'll look for full tcp/tls timings and proxy retries. if we need cold logs older than retention (not the case here) infra can do a retrieval but that takes 24-48h.

julia-rep: relaying to customer now. they asked if this is on our side or theirs — is it safe to say 'likely on our side, transient worker slowdown' ?

samir: say "likely on our side" and mention we're collecting the debug bundle to confirm. note that their payload and model look normal. recommend trying another small request to see if it repros — if it does capture req id and send it. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INC-4821 updated with devon notes and samir log snippets.

mara: customer responded and uploaded debug-bundle.tar.gz to the ticket. forwarding here.

devon: grabbing the bundle now and running the collector analysis. will post findings shortly. if anyone wants the raw query I used:```POST _search/index=logs-* { "query": { "bool": { "must": [ { "term": { "tenant_id": "acme-corp-prod-1" } }, { "term": { "request_id": "req_20260312_7c9a4b2f" } }, { "range": { "@timestamp": { "gte": "2026-03-12T14:05:00Z", "lte": "2026-03-12T14:15:00Z" } } } ] } } }```

julia-rep: thanks all — keep me posted and I’ll update the customer. :pray:
